title: Gillespie SSA and tau-leaping audit for a hidden tristable toggle
summary: Implement exact SSA, basin statistics, an alpha scan, and guarded tau-leaping for a three-gene mutual-inhibition network; the evaluator reruns the reusable solver on a hidden parameter regime.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and implement the reusable solver and exact output contract described there. Use input/model_config.json for the visible run. Save output/results.json, output/trajectory.csv, and output/gillespie_solver.py. The evaluator will execute your solver on a hidden configuration, so implement the model rather than hard-coding values.
agentMustDo: implement exact Gillespie SSA with default_rng
write the trajectory intermediate artifact and structured statistics
implement nonnegative tau-leaping and alpha scan
evaluation: Hard schema and nonnegative-state gates precede numerical comparisons. Visible statistics, scan, tau comparison, source audit, and an evaluator-only hidden rerun are scored with explicit tolerances.
